PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch S4 class

PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch-class.Rd

Container for two-phase feature-level annotation derived from spectral library matching.

Phase 1 annotates features within each library-match group (tiers 1a-1d, 2). Phase 2 extends annotation to pool features absent from the library by applying adduct rules to every confirmed M from Phase 1 (tiers 1a_exp, 1b_exp, 1c_exp).

Isotope annotation (Check_Iso_Charge) runs once on the union of all library-matched features and the full pool before either phase. Both phases only look up the resulting labels — isotope is never re-run.

Slots

library_matches

list. Output of MS1/MS2 spectral library matching.

FT

data.frame. Full feature pool table (all features, not only matched ones). Required columns: feature_name, one of mzmed/mz. Optional: rtmed/rt, intensity column (maxo/into/intensity). Pass data.frame() to run Phase 1 only.

adducts_df

data.frame. Adduct definition table with columns Ion.name, Ion.polarity, Ion.mass.

neutral_loss_table

data.frame. Neutral loss table with columns Accurate.Mass, Formula (or Neutral.Loss), Pos, Neg.

polarity

character. "pos" or "neg".

mz_threshold

numeric. Absolute m/z tolerance in Da (floor for all OR-condition ppm gates). Default 0.005.

ppm

numeric. ppm gate for Phase 1 adduct matching. Default 30. Controls confidence tier: <=5 Confirmed, <=10 Probable, <=20 Tentative, <=30 Questionable, >30 rejected.

nl_ppm

numeric. ppm gate for neutral-loss matching in both phases. Default 5.

rt_threshold

numeric. RT tolerance in seconds for Phase 1 within-group NL matching. Default 3.0.

rt_exp_threshold

numeric. RT tolerance in seconds for Phase 2 pool search (window around compound reference RT). Default 5.0.

ppm_exp

numeric. ppm gate for Phase 2 adduct search. Default 5.0.

iso_threshold

numeric. Isotope mass delta (12C/13C). Default 1.003355.

max_charge

integer. Maximum charge state for isotope detection. Default 3L.

max_isotope

integer. Maximum isotope peaks per charge state. Default 4L.
